name: archeyes
description: A diagram you talk back to — edit an AI agent's plan and send structured feedback. Interactive architecture diagrams for a plan, an existing codebase, or a feature.
author: thisAAY

scripts.gen:types: json2ts -i schema/plan-graph.schema.json -o schema/plan-graph.types.ts --additionalProperties false && json2ts -i schema/feedback.schema.json -o schema/feedback.types.ts --additionalProperties false
scripts.build:cli: esbuild cli/archeyes.ts cli/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=dist/cli --external:ajv --external:ajv-formats --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/cli/archeyes.js
scripts.build:ui: cd ui && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:ui
